title: Avoid THESE AI Stocks, Buy THIS
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Deutsche Bank sees $2.5-5.5T of spend via AI agents by 2030; he thinks adoption estimates are low; commoditised goods lose pricing power, unique goods/entertainment ad platforms win.
Reducing the pain of paying increases velocity of money and GDP — bullish for the S&P 500 broadly.

calls.reason: Meta Muse/agentic commerce take rates could add revenue (DB: +$36B by 2030, he thinks more); ~21x earnings, PEG 1.3; 20% growth at 2.6 PEG → $1,822.
calls.quote: I take a 20% growth rate... multiply that by a PEG that's closer to 2.6, I get to my $1,822 price target

calls.reason: Agentic commerce could erode Google search ad revenue (>50% of revenue), though YouTube benefits and 'all ships lift' in the boom.
calls.quote: I personally see this as a potential loser for companies like Amazon and Google because they're going to lose some of those sponsored

calls.reason: Agentic commerce raises velocity of money and GDP, feeding all S&P 500 companies.
calls.quote: Ultimately, broader economy here, S&P 500 even, all of this is relatively bullish.
